mentions.name: Renderling
mentions.description: An open-source, GPU-driven real-time renderer written in Rust that targets both native and web platforms via WebGPU. Its NLnet (NGI0 Commons Fund) funded roadmap includes a Rend3-compatible API layer and ultimately real-time global illumination via a GPU ray tracer.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on Renderling — an open-source, GPU-driven real-time renderer in Rust targeting both native and web (via WebGPU).
